reviewAssignments.details: Blocking finding F-0001: interrupted task creation may duplicate the task on retry.

findings.summary: Interrupted task creation can create a duplicate
findings.details: A failed or interrupted create can be recovered and then retried as a second task, leaving an unintended duplicate plan entry and returning a different ID. TaskService.ts:31-57 always allocates and writes a new task after entering the transaction. WorkspaceTransaction.ts:37,115-166 first replays any pending ledger write and commits it before the operation runs. Unlike TicketService.ts:43,99-114, task creation does not inspect recovered writes to recognize its already-recovered operation. Existing task tests do not exercise this recovery path. Make an interrupted task-create retry recognize the recovered creation and return its original ID without creating another task. Add an interruption/recovery regression test, while retaining distinct IDs for genuinely separate creates.

reviewAssignments.details: Accepted blocking finding F-0001: active task edit/create scope updates through TaskService.update can bypass reservation checks and create conflicting active reservations. The report's corrective action and regression test are registered in F-0001. No other findings.

findings.summary: Active task scope updates bypass reservation checks
findings.details: An active assigned, submitted, or changes-requested task can change edit/create paths through TaskService.update without validating against other active reservations, creating overlapping exclusive write reservations after assignment. TaskService.update at src/SubagentDrivenDevelopment/Services/TaskService.ts:124-158 updates editPaths/createPaths; the reservation guard at lines 368-394 only runs during assign. Prevent active edit/create scope changes or validate changes against all other active reservations in the same transaction. Add a regression test that attempts an overlapping active-task scope update and verifies rejection leaves the ledger unchanged.
